title: Macrophage-Blocking Antibodies Help Overcome Breast Cancer Endocrine Resistance
summary: A new combination therapy for hormone-resistant ER+ breast cancer shrank tumors and reprogrammed the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment in both in mouse models and in patient-derived explants.The postMacrophage-Blocking Antibodies Help Overcome Breast Cancer Endocrine Resistanceappeared first onGEN - Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology News.
